# Fetch all notes matching query 'movie recommendations' and 'movie' and print titles/pinned/tags

def fetch_all_notes(query, page_limit=20):
    page_index=0
    out=[]
    while True:
        resp=apis.simple_note.search_notes(access_token=notes_access, query=query, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
        print('query',query,'page',page_index,'returned',len(resp))
        if not resp:
            break
        out.extend(resp)
        page_index+=1
        if page_index>20:
            break
    return out

import re
notes_access=notes_login['access_token']
note=apis.simple_note.show_note(note_id=2705, access_token=notes_access)
content=note['content']
lines=[ln.rstrip() for ln in content.splitlines()]

movies=[]
current_title=None
current_director=None
for ln in lines:
    if not ln.strip():
        continue
    if ln.startswith('#'):
        continue
    # Title lines: start with non-space and not bullet
    if re.match(r'^[A-Za-z0-9].*', ln) and not ln.strip().startswith('-') and not ln.strip().startswith('*'):
        # In this note, movie titles are plain lines
        # But genres/directors lines also start with '-' after stripping, so safe.
        current_title=ln.strip()
        current_director=None
        continue
    m=re.search(r"director:\s*(.*)", ln)
    if m and current_title:
        current_director=m.group(1).strip()
        movies.append((current_title,current_director))

print('total_movie_director_pairs', len(movies))
# Filter for Peter Jackson director
pj=[title for title,dirr in movies if dirr=='Peter Jackson']
print('pj_raw', pj)
# unique preserve order
seen=set(); pj_unique=[]
for t in pj:
    if t not in seen:
        seen.add(t); pj_unique.append(t)
print('pj_unique', pj_unique)
print('comma_separated', ', '.join(pj_unique))
